messages:
zoe_csops: Heads-up: got alerts about a surge of 'welcome_sequence' runs targeting accounts that already completed onboarding. ~220 runs in 2h. Feels like a retry storm.
matt_data: I'm seeing a tight loop in playbook runner: webhook responses returning 503 -> runner retries with exponential backoff but max_retries was set to 0 accidentally in the new runner config, so the client side kept re-posting.
riley_onboard: Which webhook? We have a suppression that should stop welcome_sequence from running on completed accounts.
zoe_csops: The trigger includes `a.onboarding_state = 'complete'` normally, but the webhook body we receive only had account_id and no onboarding_state (we rely on playbook service to fetch account snapshot). If runner replays the webhook repeatedly before the account snapshot fetch completes, it queues duplicate runs.
esa_ops: Can you paste the runner logs? I pulled a snippet: ```2026-07-15T18:12:01Z runner RECEIVE webhook id=wh_991 payload={"account":"acct-33a"} status=queued
2026-07-15T18:12:02Z runner POST /playbooks/execute 503 retry=1 client_id=runner-07
2026-07-15T18:12:02Z webhook-retry client resend id=wh_991 attempt=2
2026-07-15T18:12:03Z runner POST /playbooks/execute 503 retry=2
...```
playbook-bot: alert: welcome_sequence queued=220 failures=0 avg_retry_delay=1.2s note=possible-replay-loop
matt_data: Root cause looks like two things: 1) ingestion-service responded 200 to webhook but playbook-service transiently responded 503 (brief DB timeout), and 2) webhook client retry interval is aggressive (1s) and dedupe window in playbook runner is only 500ms.
riley_onboard: So duplicates happen before a canonical account lookup or before the idempotency key is stored.
esa_ops: Immediate mitigations: A) Increase dedupe window to 10s in runner, B) Set webhook client to use exponential backoff starting at 2s, max_retries=5, C) Pause welcome_sequence until warmfix applied: `/playbook pause welcome_sequence --reason "retry-storm hotfix"`.
zoe_csops: I'll pause now. Also need to cancel queued duplicate runs and check outbound sends. If any customers got duplicate welcome emails, we must suppress follow-ups.
matt_data: Hotfix prepared: updating runner config on pb-canary-01 to `dedupe_window_ms=10000` and client backoff to `initial=2000ms, multiplier=2.0`. Also adding a server-side idempotency check that rejects runs with same webhook id within 1h. Pushing to canary.
playbook-bot: command acknowledged: welcome_sequence paused by zoe_csops at 2026-07-15T18:28:10Z reason=retry-storm hotfix
esa_ops: Backfill query to find dup runs: ```SELECT pr.id, pr.account, pr.payload->>'webhook_id' AS wh FROM playbook_runs pr WHERE pr.name='welcome_sequence' AND pr.created_at > now() - interval '3 hours' GROUP BY pr.id,pr.account,wh HAVING count(*)>1;``` I'll cancel duplicates after review (limit 200).
riley_onboard: If any duplicate outbound sends found, we'll trigger the apology-lite flow and mark accounts with `outbound_suppressed_until=now()+interval '48 hours'`.
zoe_csops: Postmortem items: 1) tighten runner dedupe window and add server idempotency, 2) add webhook replay resilience test in CI (simulate transient 503s), 3) update playbook docs to require webhook_id presence and add a deploy checklist item for runner config. Creating CSOPS ticket CSOPS-15031 and assigning owners. ETA initial mitigation 40m. :white_check_mark:
